description: Thoughtful gift ideas for anyone, tailored to who they are and your budget.

capabilities: Find personalized gift ideas by recipient, interests, and budget
Get quick gift lists under a set budget
defaultPrompt: Gift ideas under $50 for my dad who loves fishing
My sister likes skincare, birthday next week, budget $100
Cheap stocking stuffers under $15 for a teenager who games
interface.longDescription: Stop staring at a blank gift list. Describe who you are shopping for, what they like, and your budget, and get thoughtful, tailored gift ideas in seconds. Need something fast? Ask for a quick list under any budget, optionally tuned to the recipient. Great for birthdays, holidays, anniversaries, and the coworker you barely know.

review.commerce_description: This app is free to use. Product recommendations include affiliate links (Amazon Associates and Awin); the developer may earn a commission if you purchase through them, at no extra cost to you. The app does not process payments itself.

name: gift-finder
